post.description:
Sign in with Employee ID and password (CR-02). A wrong EID and a wrong password both
answer 401 ``credentials_invalid``; the fifth wrong password in a row answers 403
``account_locked`` with ``details.until`` (CR-07).
Step 3: choose a password and sign in. 422 ``password_weak`` (CR-05).

Step 1 of setup or reset: text a code to the number on file (CR-03, CR-06).
404 ``eid_unknown``, 409 ``no_phone_on_file``, 429 ``resend_too_soon``, 403
``code_locked``.

Step 2: the code. 401 ``code_invalid`` (with ``details.attempts_left``) or
``code_expired``; the fifth wrong code answers 403 ``code_locked`` (CR-04).

post.description:
Redeem a reward. The coins come off at once; the request waits for approval, or is
ready straight away when approval is off. Refusals carry the eligibility code and its
params as ``details``: 403 ``locked_tier``, ``locked_badge``; 409 ``reward_limit``,
``monthly_rewards_used``, ``monthly_coin_cap``, ``coins_short``,
``store_budget_used``. Also 404 ``reward_not_found`` (hidden or deleted); 409
``redeem_conflict`` in the rare case another redeem moved a limit mid-way and it no
longer applies (try again); 422 ``idempotency_key_required``,
``idempotency_key_reused``.

post.description:
A GM approves a request at their store (MG-06). 403 ``cannot_decide`` for another
store's, their own, or a GM's, supervisor's or director's (owners decide those). 404
``request_not_found``; 409 ``request_not_pending`` (details.status) once decided, so
a second click changes nothing.

Handed over at the store (plan G5). 409 ``request_not_approved`` (details.status)
unless it is approved; 403 ``cannot_decide`` as for approve.

A GM declines: the coins, the monthly count and cap and the store budget come back,
and the person is notified (MG-06). 403 ``cannot_decide``, 404 ``request_not_found``,
409 ``request_not_pending`` as for approve.

get.description:
The Rewards screen (CR-24, CR-25): balance, the monthly limits card and the active
rewards by cost, each with ``eligibility {ok, code, params}``. Codes, first failure in
the spec's order: ``locked_tier`` (tier_id, tier_name, tier_name_es), ``locked_badge``
(badge_id, badge_name, badge_name_es), ``reward_limit`` (limit),
``monthly_rewards_used`` (max), ``monthly_coin_cap`` (max), ``coins_short`` (short),
``store_budget_used``.
